verses.en: And, behold, there came a man of God out of Judah by the word of the LORD unto Beth-el: and Jeroboam stood by the altar to burn incense.
verses.sm: FAAUTA foi, ua sau le tagata o le Atua, i le afioga a Ieova, mai Iuta i Peteli; o loo tu mai foi Ierepoamo i tafatafa o le fata faitaulaga e faamu ai mea manogi.

verses.en: And he cried against the altar in the word of the LORD, and said, O altar, altar, thus saith the LORD; Behold, a child shall be born unto the house of David, Josiah by name; and upon thee shall he offer the priests of the high places that burn incense upon thee, and men's bones shall be burnt upon thee.
verses.sm: Ona alaga atu lea o ia i le fata faitaulaga i le afioga a Ieova, ua ia faapea atu, Le fata faitaulaga e, le fata faitaulaga e, o loo faapea ona fetalai mai o Ieova, Faauta o le a fanau mai le tama i le aiga o Tavita, e igoa ia Iosia, na te fai taulaga i luga ia te oe i le au faitaulaga o mea maualuluga, o e faamu mea manogi i luga ia te oe, e susunuina foi ivi o tagata i luga ia te oe.

verses.en: And he gave a sign the same day, saying, This is the sign which the LORD hath spoken; Behold, the altar shall be rent, and the ashes that are upon it shall be poured out.
verses.sm: Ona avane lea e ia o le faailoga i lea lava aso, ua faapea atu, O le faailoga lenei ua fetalai mai ai Ieova; faauta, e māvae le fata faitaulaga, e masaa ai foi le lefulefu o loo i ona luga.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when king Jeroboam heard the saying of the man of God, which had cried against the altar in Beth-el, that he put forth his hand from the altar, saying, Lay hold on him. And his hand, which he put forth against him, dried up, so that he could not pull it in again to him.
verses.sm: Ua faalogo le tupu i le upu a le tagata o le Atua, ua ia alaga atu ai i le fata faitaulaga i Peteli, ona aapa atu lea e Ierepoamo o lona lima nai le fata faitaulaga, ua faapea atu, Ina pue ia ia te ia; ona gase lea o lona lima na ia aapa atu ia te ia, ua le toe mafai ona faafoi ai ia te ia.

verses.en: The altar also was rent, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had given by the word of the LORD.
verses.sm: Ua māvae foi le fata faitaulaga, ua masaa foi le lefulefu na i le fata faitaulaga, e tusa ma le faailoga na avane e le tagata o le Atua i le afioga a Ieova.

verses.en: And the king answered and said unto the man of God, Intreat now the face of the LORD thy God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored me again. And the man of God besought the LORD, and the king's hand was restored him again, and became as it was before.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o le tupu, ua faapea atu i le tagata o le Atua, Ia e aioi atu i luma o Ieova lou Atua, ma e tatalo atu mo a‘u, ina ia toe lelei lo‘u lima. Oea aioi atu ai lea o le tagata o le Atua i luma o Ieova, ona toe lelei lea o le lima o le tupu ua pei o anamua.

verses.en: And the king said unto the man of God, Come home with me, and refresh thyself, and I will give thee a reward.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o le tupu i le tagata o le Atua, Se‘i ta o ma a‘u i lo‘u fale, e te malolo ai, ou te avatu foi ia te oe se mea alōfa.

verses.en: And the man of God said unto the king, If thou wilt give me half thine house, I will not go in with thee, neither will I eat bread nor drink water in this place:
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o le tagata o le Atua i le tupu, Afai e te foai mai ia te au le vaeluagalemu o mea o i lou fale, ta te le o faatasi ma oe ; ou te le ‘ai ni mea e ‘ai, ou te le inu vai foi i lenei mea.

verses.en: For so was it charged me by the word of the LORD, saying, Eat no bread, nor drink water, nor turn again by the same way that thou camest.
verses.sm: Auā na faapea ona fetalai mai ai ia te au o le afioga a Ieova, na faapea mai, Aua e te ‘ai i mea e ‘ai, auā ne‘i e inu foi: i le vai, aua foi le toe foi mai i le ala e te alu atu ai.

verses.en: So he went another way, and returned not by the way that he came to Beth-el.
verses.sm: Ona alu atu lea o ia i le tasi ala, ua le foi atu o ia i le ala na ia alu atu ai i Peteli.

verses.en: Now there dwelt an old prophet in Beth-el; and his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Beth-el: the words which he had spoken unto the king, them they told also to their father.
verses.sm: Sa nofo i Peteli le tasi perofeta ua toeaina; na o atu ona atalii, ma talatala atu ia te ia i mea uma na faia e le tagata o le Atua i lena aso i Peteli; o upu foi na ia fai atu ai i le tupu ua latou talatala atu ai i lo latou tamā.

verses.en: And their father said unto them, What way went he? For his sons had seen what way the man of God went, which came from Judah.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o lo latou tamā ia te i latou, O le fea ala na alu atu ai o ia ? Auā na iloa e ona atalii le ala na alu atu ai le tagata o le Atua, o le na sau mai Iuta.

verses.en: And he said unto his sons, Saddle me the ass. So they saddled him the ass: and he rode thereon,
verses.sm: Ua ia fai atu foi i ona atalii, Ina faanofoa ia le asini mo a‘u ; ona latou faanofoa ai lea o le asini m@ ia;

verses.en: And went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak: and he said unto him, Art thou the man of God that camest from Judah? And he said, I am.
verses.sm: ona tietie ai lea o ia. Ona mulimuli atu lea o ia i le tagata o le Atua, na ia maua atu ia te ia o nofo i lalo o le tapeneto ; onā fai atu lea o ia ia te ia, O oe ea le tagata o le Atua na sau mai Iuta ? Ona tali mai lea o ia, O a‘u lenei.

verses.en: Then he said unto him, Come home with me, and eat bread.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o ia ia te ia, Ta te o ma a‘u i lo‘u fale, se‘i e tausami sina mea.

verses.en: And he said, I may not return with thee, nor go in with thee: neither will I eat bread nor drink water with thee in this place:
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o ia, Ou te le mafai ona ta toe foi atu ma oe, ma te ulufale atu ma oe, ou te le ‘ai i mea e ai, ou te le inu foi i le vai faatasi ma oe i lenei mea;

verses.en: For it was said to me by the word of the LORD, Thou shalt eat no bread nor drink water there, nor turn again to go by the way that thou camest.
verses.sm: auā na fetalai mai ia te au i le afioga a ieova, Aua e te ‘ai i mea e ‘ai, pe inu vai i lea mea; aua foi e te liliu mai ma toe foi mai i le ala e te alu atu ai.

verses.en: He said unto him, I am a prophet also as thou art; and an angel spake unto me by the word of the LORD, saying, Bring him back with thee into thine house, that he may eat bread and drink water. But he lied unto him.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o ia ia te ia, O a‘u foi o le perofeta e pei o oe; ua fai mai foi le agelu ia te au i le afioga a Ieova, ua faapea mai, Ina e toe faafoi mai ia ia te ia faatasi ma oe i lou fale, ina ia ‘ai o ia i mea e ‘ai, ma inu i le vai. A ua tala pepelo o ia ia te ia.

verses.en: So he went back with him, and did eat bread in his house, and drank water.
verses.sm: Ona la toe foi atu lea ma ia, ua ia ‘ai foi i mea e ‘ai i lona fale, ma inu vai.

verses.en: And it came to pass, as they sat at the table, that the word of the LORD came unto the prophet that brought him back:
verses.sm: Ua oo mai le afioga a Ieova i le perofeta na toe faafoi atu ia te ia, a o la nonofo i le laulau.

verses.en: And he cried unto the man of God that came from Judah, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Forasmuch as thou hast disobeyed the mouth of the LORD, and hast not kept the commandment which the LORD thy God commanded thee,
verses.sm: Ona alaga atu lea o ia i le tagata o le Atua na sau mai Iuta, ua faapea atu, O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o Ieova, Ua e fouvale i ]e afioga a Ieova, ua e le tausi foi i le poloaiga na fetalai mai ai Ieova lou Atua ia te oe,

verses.en: But camest back, and hast eaten bread and drunk water in the place, of the which the LORD did say to thee, Eat no bread, and drink no water; thy carcase shall not come unto the sepulchre of thy fathers.
verses.sm: A ua e toe foi mai, ma e ‘ai i mea e ‘ai, ma e inu vai i le mea na fetalai mai ai Ieova ia te oe, aua e te ;ai ai i mea e ‘ai, pe inu vai, o le mea lea e le oo ai lou tino i le tuugamau o ou tamā.

verses.en: And it came to pass, after he had eaten bread, and after he had drunk, that he saddled for him the ass, to wit, for the prophet whom he had brought back.
verses.sm: Ua uma ona ia ‘ai i mea e ‘ai, ua uma foi ona ia inu, ona faanofoa lea e ia o le asini mo ia, mo le perofeta o le na ia toe faafoi mai.

verses.en: And when he was gone, a lion met him by the way, and slew him: and his carcase was cast in the way, and the ass stood by it, the lion also stood by the carcase.
verses.sm: Ua alu ia, ona maua lea o ia e le leona i le ala, ua oti o ia ia te ia ; ua lafo ifo foi lona tino i le ala, ua tu le asini e latalata i ai, ua tu foi le leona e latalata i le tino.

verses.en: And, behold, men passed by, and saw the carcase cast in the way, and the lion standing by the carcase: and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet dwelt.
verses.sm: Faauta foi i tagata ua o ane, ua latou iloa le tino ua lafo ifo i le ala, ma le leona ua tu mai e latalata i le tino; ona latou o ai lea, ma talatala atu ai i le aai sa nofo ai le perofeta toeaina.

verses.en: And when the prophet that brought him back from the way heard thereof, he said, It is the man of God, who was disobedient unto the word of the LORD: therefore the LORD hath delivered him unto the lion, which hath torn him, and slain him, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake unto him.
verses.sm: Ua faalogo i ai le perofeta o le na toe faafoi atu ia te ia i le ala, ooa faapea ane lea o ia, O le tagata o le Atua lea, o le ila fouvale i le afioga a Ieova; o le mea lea ua tuuina atu ai o ia e Ieova i le leona, ua saei ia te ia, ua oti ai o ia, e tusa ma le afioga a Ieova na ia fetalai mai ai ia te ia.

verses.en: And he spake to his sons, saying, Saddle me the ass. And they saddled him.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o ia i ona atalii, ua faapea atu, Ina faanofoa ia le asini mo a‘u. Ona latou faanofoaina lea.

verses.en: And he went and found his carcase cast in the way, and the ass and the lion standing by the carcase: the lion had not eaten the carcase, nor torn the ass.
verses.sm: Ua alu o ia, ona maua lea e ia o lona tino ua lafo ifo i le ala, ma le asini ma le leona o ioo tutū e latalata ane i le tino; ua le ‘aina e le leona o le tino, ua le saeia foi e ia le asini.

verses.en: And the prophet took up the carcase of the man of God, and laid it upon the ass, and brought it back: and the old prophet came to the city, to mourn and to bury him.
verses.sm: Ona avae lea e le perofeta o le tino o le tagata o le Atua, ma faaee ai i luga o le asini, ma toe avatu ai; ona alu atu lea o le perofeta toeaina i le aai e tagitu‘i ma tanu ia te ia.

verses.en: And he laid his carcase in his own grave; and they mourned over him, saying, Alas, my brother!
verses.sm: Ua ia tuuina lona tino i lona lava tuugamau; ona latou taufaitagitu‘i lea ia te ia, ua faapea, Aue lo‘u uso e!

verses.en: And it came to pass, after he had buried him, that he spake to his sons, saying, When I am dead, then bury me in the sepulchre wherein the man of God is buried; lay my bones beside his bones:
verses.sm: Ua uma ona tanu ia te ia, ona fai atu lea o ia i ona atalii, ua faapea atu, Pe a ou oti, ia outou tanu ia te a.u i le tuugamau ua tanumia ai le tagata o le Atua, ia tuu o‘u ivi i tafatafa o ona ivi;

verses.en: For the saying which he cried by the word of the LORD against the altar in Beth-el, and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria, shall surely come to pass.
verses.sm: auā e taunuu lava le upu na ia valaau atu ai i le afioga a Ieova i le fata faitaulaga o loo i Peteli, ma fale uma o mea maualuluga o loo i ai i aai o Samaria.

verses.en: After this thing Jeroboam returned not from his evil way, but made again of the lowest of the people priests of the high places: whosoever would, he consecrated him, and he became one of the priests of the high places.
verses.sm: Ua mavae lenei mea, ua le liliu ese Ierepoamo i lona ala leaga, a ua toe faia e ia o tagata mai le nuu uma ma faitaulaga o mea maualuluga; ai se manao i ai ua ia tofia o ia, ona avea lea o ia ma faitaulaga o mea maualuluga.

verses.en: And this thing became sin unto the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off, and to destroy it from off the face of the earth.
verses.sm: Na avea lenei mea ma agasala i le aiga o Ierepoamo, ia vavaeeseina ma faaumatia i le fogāeleele. O le mai o le atalii o Ierepoamo.
